title: Faster, predictive search for Supabase Docs and Knowledge Base
summary: Faster, predictive search for Supabase Docs and Knowledge Base
body_markdown:
We rebuilt search on[Supabase Docs](https://supabase.com/docs) and the[Supabase Knowledge Base](https://supabase.com/kb) to get you to the right page with less effort.


- **Results as you type.** Search returns matches while you type, so you no longer need to submit a query first.
- **See why a result matched.** Each result highlights your keywords and shows the full heading path inside the page.
- **Better results for short queries.** Most searches are a few words, like "API keys" or "RLS". Search now ranks pages by how well they match your keywords, which works well for short queries.
- **Typos and partial words still find results.** If you misspell a term or stop typing early, search still returns close matches.
- **Ask AI when nothing matches.** If search finds no results, it offers to send your question to Ask AI.


Open search from any docs or knowledge base page with` Cmd+K` (macOS) or` Ctrl+K` (Windows and Linux).
